mapper.sql: id, control_id, session_id, owner_key, source_run_id, source_request_id, tool_invocation_id, tool_call_id, reason, stream_url, hold_until, status, resume_request_id, resume_run_id, agent_id, max_step
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ai_agent_desktop_control (control_id, session_id, owner_key, source_run_id, source_request_id, tool_invocation_id, tool_call_id, reason, stream_url, hold_until, status, resume_request_id, resume_run_id, agent_id, max_step) VALUES (#{controlId}, #{sessionId}, #{ownerKey}, #{sourceRunId}, #{sourceRequestId}, #{toolInvocationId}, #{toolCallId}, #{reason}, #{streamUrl}, #{holdUntil}, #{status}, #{resumeRequestId}, #{resumeRunId}, #{agentId}, #{maxStep})
mapper.select: SELECT FROM ai_agent_desktop_control WHERE session_id = #{sessionId} ORDER BY create_time DESC, id DESC LIMIT 100
mapper.update: UPDATE ai_agent_desktop_control SET status = 'RESUMING' WHERE resume_request_id = #{resumeRequestId} AND status = 'RESUME_PENDING'
UPDATE ai_agent_desktop_control SET status = 'COMPLETED' WHERE control_id = #{controlId} AND status = 'RESUMING'
UPDATE ai_agent_desktop_control SET status = 'FAILED' WHERE control_id = #{controlId} AND status IN ('PENDING', 'RESUMING')
UPDATE ai_agent_desktop_control SET status = 'EXPIRED' WHERE control_id = #{controlId} AND status = 'PENDING' AND hold_until <= UNIX_TIMESTAMP()
